sleeping.goal: Cure the sleeping smith, or break his keeping light
sleeping.journal: Under the floor of an old home I found a smith asleep in a cell, a red light burning on the wall over him. He has the blight in him, and the light holds it.

cured_asleep.goal: Wait for the smith to wake
cured_asleep.journal: I gave {giver} the cure while he slept. He never stirred.

his_day.goal: Cure the smith before the day is out

journal.?mark:keeping_turned: The light went out and nobody brought {giver} the cure in time.
journal.?: The light went out and {giver} woke coughing. I got the cure into him before his day was out.

say: You. You came down for me. I heard the light go and thought, well, that's the end of it. And here you are, and the cold's going out of my hands.
I'm a smith. It's all I've got that's worth giving. Tell me what you want for it and I'll make it to your measure.

iron.say: Iron, then. Good honest iron, and I've a little put by. Which piece?

replies.journal: {giver} is making me a helmet in iron.
{giver} is making me a chestplate in iron.
{giver} is making me leggings in iron.
{giver} is making me boots in iron.

diamond.say: Show me, then. Which piece? A helmet takes five, a chestplate eight, leggings seven and boots four.

replies.journal: I gave {giver} 5 diamonds. He is making me a helmet from them.
I gave {giver} 8 diamonds. He is making me a chestplate from them.
I gave {giver} 7 diamonds. He is making me leggings from them.
I gave {giver} 4 diamonds. He is making me boots from them.

forging.journal: {giver} is back at his forge. He said to come back in a day or two.

collect.goal: Collect what the smith made you
say: There. Try it on. If it pinches, it's your fault for growing.
I keep the old rite over everything I make, the same words that kept me. It won't rust on you.
I've been sick, they tell me. Asleep under the floor of my own house, and I don't remember a day of it.
Cured me? In my sleep? Anyone could walk in here and say that. I'll thank you not to tell me tales. Out of my house.

turned.text: Nobody got the cure into {giver} in time. He rose as one of the dead, like his household upstairs. The keeping only ever bought him time.

unbelieved.text: {giver} woke well and never believed I was the one who cured him. I got nothing for it but the walk.

waived.text: {giver} wanted to make me something for the cure. I told him to get his strength back first.

diamond_helmet.text: {giver} forged me a helmet in diamond for the cure, made to my measure.

diamond_chestplate.text: {giver} forged me a chestplate in diamond for the cure, made to my measure.

diamond_leggings.text: {giver} forged me leggings in diamond for the cure, made to my measure.

diamond_boots.text: {giver} forged me boots in diamond for the cure, made to my measure.

iron_helmet.text: {giver} forged me a helmet in iron for the cure, made to my measure.

iron_chestplate.text: {giver} forged me a chestplate in iron for the cure, made to my measure.

iron_leggings.text: {giver} forged me leggings in iron for the cure, made to my measure.

iron_boots.text: {giver} forged me boots in iron for the cure, made to my measure.
